Materials.ValidateMaterialUseCounts              - Validate the material use count
- Use Case: Creating thin-walled features like ribs, brackets, or sheet metal-like geometry
* axis (string or number, required): Rotation axis - "x", "y", "z" or entity token for a ConstructionAxis, SketchLine, or linear BRepEdge
* directionOneAxis (string or number, required): Primary direction - "x", "y", "z" or entity token for a ConstructionAxis, SketchLine, or linear BRepEdge
Unlike 3D circularPattern, this operates on sketch geometry (lines, circles, arcs) as geometric constraints.
Unlike 3D rectangularPattern, this operates on sketch geometry as geometric constraints.
- Can reference sketch profiles or BRep faces

* axisToken (number or string, required): Axis of revolution - entity token (number) for a ConstructionAxis, SketchLine, or linear BRepEdge, OR a string "x", "y", "z" to use a predefined construction axis
- holeType (string): Hole geometry type (default: "simple")
* ONLY valid when extentType="all", ignored for other extent types
* Valid entity types: BRepBody, BRepFace, BRepVertex, ConstructionPlane, ConstructionPoint
* ONLY valid when extentType="to", ignored otherwise
